findings.original: co-operation is a necessary concomitant of all production on a large scale
findings.rewrite: cooperation goes hand in hand with all production on a large scale
findings.problem: "Necessary" is dropped, so a claim of necessity becomes one of mere accompaniment.
findings.fix: cooperation necessarily goes hand in hand with all production on a large scale

findings.original: a certain minimum amount of capital was necessary, in order that the number of labourers simultaneously employed, and, consequently, the amount of surplus-value produced, might suffice to liberate the employer
findings.rewrite: a certain minimum amount of capital was necessary. The number of workers employed at the same time, and so the amount of surplus-value produced, had to be large enough to free the employer
findings.problem: The split drops "in order that", so the minimum capital is no longer stated to be what makes the required number of workers possible.
findings.fix: a certain minimum amount of capital was necessary so that the number of workers employed at the same time, and so the amount of surplus-value produced, might be large enough to free the employer

findings.original: requires, more or less, a directing authority, in order to secure the harmonious working of the individual activities, and to perform the general functions
findings.rewrite: needs, more or less, a directing authority. This authority secures the harmonious working of the individual activities and performs the general functions
findings.problem: Marx states the purpose for which the authority is needed; the rewrite turns this into a flat claim that the authority actually secures harmony.
findings.fix: needs, more or less, a directing authority, to secure the harmonious working of the individual activities and to perform the general functions

notes_review: The logged calls are sound: leaving "concentration of the means of production" unexplained avoids importing the Ch. 25 sense, the nine-way "may" split in p013 keeps the alternatives as possibilities, and "improbably right" is rightly kept as printed. The p020 restructuring keeps the conditional and the substance/form contrast intact.
summary: Fidelity is good: the Jones quotation, the political economist's double standard and the Spectator's "Quelle horreur!" all keep their voice, but p027 drops "necessary" and two splits weaken purpose links. Readability is good throughout.
